_readme: دفعةُ رسوماتِ جيميناي — يقرؤُها سيرُ عمل n8n «شوجب — مولّد رسومات الأسئلة».
لماذا ملفٌّ في المستودعِ لا قائمةٌ داخلَ العقدة (قرارُ المالك ٢٠٢٦-٠٨-٢٧):
كانت الدفعةُ تُكتَبُ في كودِ العقدةِ نفسِها، فكلُّ دفعةٍ تكلّفُ ثلاثَ جولات:
تعديلُ العقدةِ ثمّ نشرُها ثمّ تشغيلُها. وصارت الدفعةُ الآنَ **دفعةَ git واحدة**
إلى فرعِ main ثمّ تشغيلٌ واحد — فسقطت خطوتانِ من كلِّ دورة.
الاستعمال:
١) حرّرْ items أدناه، وغيّرْ batchId إلى قيمةٍ جديدة.
٢) ادفعْ إلى main.
٣) شغّلِ السيرَ (execute_workflow) — يقرأُ هذا الملفَّ عبرَ واجهةِ GitHub.
٤) الصورُ تُودَعُ في فرعِ `graphics-inbox` تحتَ graphics-inbox/<name>.jpg
⚠️ batchId ليس زينةً: العقدةُ تُعيدُه مع كلِّ عنصر، فتتحقّقُ الجلسةُ أنّ
التشغيلَ قرأَ الدفعةَ الجديدةَ لا نسخةً مخزَّنةً في ذاكرةِ وسيط.
⚠️ والصورُ تُودَعُ في فرعٍ مستقلٍّ عمداً — كانت تُودَعُ في فرعِ العملِ فيُضطَرُّ
كلُّ إيداعٍ إلى دمجٍ يدويّ. والفرعُ المستقلُّ يُلغي ذلك.
شكلُ العنصر:
{ "name": "latin-slug", "subject": "وصفٌ إنجليزيٌّ للجسم" }
← يُبنى البرومبتُ حولَه بورقةِ المواصفاتِ البصرية.
{ "name": "...", "subject": "...", "face": true }
← أعضاءُ الحواسِّ: يُستبدَلُ قيدُ «بلا وجه» بقيدِ العضوِ المعزول.
{ "name": "...", "prompt": "برومبتٌ كاملٌ جاهز" }
← يتخطّى البناءَ كلَّه. يُستعمَلُ حينَ تُغري قائمةُ الهيكسات النموذجَ
برسمِ لوحةِ ألوانٍ داخلَ الصورة (وقعَ فعلاً مع رسمةِ العين).

items.name: btn-leather-en-2026-09-15-en-btn-leather
items.prompt:
Create a single wide horizontal capsule-shaped (stadium-shaped) button icon for a children's educational app UI, viewed frontally, filling almost the entire 1536x384 canvas edge to edge with only a thin margin of white around it.

SHAPE: a horizontal capsule / stadium shape — fully rounded semicircular left and right ends, perfectly straight parallel top and bottom edges in between. A single flat button face. Completely plain and empty inside: absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no symbols anywhere on it.

MATERIAL: rich warm brown leather / book-cloth texture, like the cover of a hardcover storybook. Shaded with a smooth vertical gradient: a pale warm cream highlight along the very top edge, transitioning through a warm tan-brown in the upper-middle, to a deeper saddle-brown in the lower-middle, down to a dark chocolate-brown shadow along the very bottom edge. A very subtle fine leather-grain texture across the surface (subtle, not busy or noisy). A soft elongated white gloss highlight band running horizontally across the upper third of the button for a gentle shine.

EMBROIDERED STITCHED EDGE (the most important feature): a neat, clearly visible hand-embroidered running stitch — a single row of small, evenly-spaced short thread dashes — following the entire outline of the capsule shape, placed just inside the outer edge, all the way around including the two rounded end-caps. The stitching thread color must be a soft pale cream / ivory / off-white color only. The stitching must NOT be gold, NOT be yellow, and NOT be metallic in any way — it is plain pale cream sewing thread, the same idea as visible stitching on a leather wallet or bag.

OUTLINE: a thin, crisp, dark brown (almost black, like #2a1608) outline tracing the entire outer silhouette of the capsule shape.

STYLE: glossy flat cartoon-sticker illustration style consistent with a children's educational app, warm and friendly, plump rounded form with no sharp corners anywhere, the button floating with no ground line and no cast shadow beneath it.

COLOR RESTRICTION: use only warm brown, tan, cream and dark chocolate-brown tones for the leather body and its stitching. Do absolutely NOT use any gold, yellow, orange-yellow, or metallic gold color anywhere in the image, not on the leather, not on the stitching, not anywhere.

BACKGROUND: pure flat white background outside the button shape, so it can be keyed out later.

ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN: any text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermarks, logos, gold color, yellow color, or metallic color anywhere in the image. One single standalone button image only, filling the canvas — not a grid, not multiple buttons, not a set of color swatches, not a frame with a window cut out of it.
